record: Verbatim deployed source of the ACTIVE edge function, retrieved read-only from the platform.
why: The deployed function was published by hand (no workflow in .github/workflows deploys Supabase functions). Its source was never committed, so production was unreproducible and a deploy from any branch would have silently replaced it. This directory is a record only: nothing here is imported, built, or deployed.
doNotDeployWarning: Do not deploy bare main or the older draft. Reconcile from released native source 3bb41252 under review.
latentHazard: The deployed scopedProductTcpEnabled===true branch POSTs to /functions/v1/cos-exact-product-tcp, which is NOT a deployed function. The flag reads false in the bundle. Do not enable it.

draftBranchComparison.finding: The draft branch is NOT the deployed tree either. Production runs a third state that is neither main nor this branch.
draftBranchComparison.literalOverlapCaveat: Quoted-literal overlap is a weak heuristic and weakest on the smallest files; esbuild inlining can depress it. Treat 100% as strong evidence of sameness and the lower figures as unresolved, not as proven divergence.

deploymentCiStatus: Separate reviewed backend delivery was intentional for this release. Permanently omitting deployment CI was NOT a documented decision, and the source-publication gap needs fixing. Agreed order: (1) preserve the exact native source and a reproducible build in reviewed version control, (2) add CI that VERIFIES the artifact without deploying it, (3) automated deployment is a separate decision requiring approval.
